source.readHash: function readHash() { const h = location.hash.replace(/^#/, ''); if (!h.includes('=')) return; const q = Object.fromEntries(h.split('&').map(kv => kv.split('='))); if (q.v) S.view = q.v; if (q.stage) S.stage = q.stage; if (q.project && S.projects.some(p => p.id === q.project)) { if (q.project !== S.projectId) { S.projectId = q.project; const os = options(project()); S.compare = os.filter(o => o.status !== 'Rejected').slice(0, 2).map(o => o.id); S.optionId = os[0] ? os[0].id : null; } } if (q.option && options(project()).some(o => o.id === q.option)) S.optionId = q.option; if (q.depth && DEPTHS.includes(q.depth)) S.depth = q.depth; if (q.case) S.basis.case = q.case; if (q.hz) S.basis.horizon = +q.hz; if (q.hist) S.basis.histYear = +q.hist; if (q.cmp != null) { const ids = q.cmp.split(',').filter(Boolean); if (ids.length) S.compare = ids.filter(id => optionById(id)); } if (q.pins != null) S.pins = q.pins.split(',').filter(Boolean).map(Number).filter(id => GS.node(id)).slice(0, 5); S.listView = q.list === '1'; S.selectedBlock = q.block || null; }
